As with all [[mithril weapon]]ry, it requires 20 [[Attack]] to wield. At level 64 [[Smithing]], players can make one from three [[mithril bar]]s, granting 150 Smithing [[experience]]. Players can also purchase one from a few shops, including [[Gaius' Two Handed Shop]] in [[Taverley]] and [[Gulluck and Sons]] in the [[Grand Tree]].
